environment: Local managed cloud onboarding PostgreSQL; current catalog checks use actual PostgreSQL, not PGlite.

verification.mode: read-only repeatable-read transactions through separate owner and authenticated app_service connections

recordedMigrationReplay.command: npm run db:migrate:deploy (existing provisioned database), followed by canonical runtime readiness verifier
recordedMigrationReplay.exitStatusBasis: Controller-observed completion; retained transcript reports schema migration completion and successful runtime readiness.
qualifications: The deploy replay completed before the merge commit; the four company migration journal hashes below match the current merged source.
This is an additive replay against the existing provisioned local PostgreSQL database; it does not establish a fresh empty-database bootstrap or an AWS/production rollout.
The transcript includes two skipped non-public UUID isolation targets reported as unprovisioned/drift; all five public integer-keyed company tables were independently checked below.
pgaudit was not loaded on this local server; this does not establish a database-level audit configuration.

The company registry migration copies/verifies legacy settings before removing the settings array and refuses later legacy-array writes; production cutover requires a company-document write pause and all old API workers updated, as documented in docs/design/COMPANY_LEGAL_REGISTRY.md.
No second migration replay, full installer rerun, destructive probe or production data qualification was performed for this evidence.

companyTableRls.sharedPredicate: ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.rls_enforce'::text, true), ''::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'::text) OR (organization_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text))::integer) OR (organization_id = ("substring"(current_setting('app.current_org_id'::text, true), '^[0-9]+$'::text))::integer) OR (current_setting('app.current_user_role'::text, true) = 'app_super_admin'::text))
companyTableRls.qualification: Forced RLS and canonical policy catalog shape are verified. Runtime policy filtering depends on the application setting app.rls_enforce=on and authoritative tenant/role request context; no new behavioral cross-tenant fixture was created.

indexes.comparison: All 13 expected PostgreSQL pg_get_indexdef strings matched exact expected keys, direction, uniqueness and partial predicates; all indexes valid and ready.

entries.name: audit_company_legal_copy_lineage_idx
entries.definition: CREATE INDEX audit_company_legal_copy_lineage_idx ON public.audit_logs USING btree (tenant_id, record_id) WHERE ((table_name = 'vault_document'::text) AND (action = ANY (ARRAY['vault.document.ingest'::text, 'vault.document.reupload'::text])))

receiptBinding.name: tenant_export_receipts_company_documents_binding
receiptBinding.definition: CHECK ((((company_documents_version IS NULL) AND (company_documents_sha256 IS NULL)) OR ((company_documents_version IS NOT NULL) AND (company_documents_version = 1) AND (company_documents_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (company_documents_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text))))

retentionAndReceiptCatalog.qualification: Catalog presence/enabled state only; destructive trigger behavior and hold/receipt races are covered by the separately recorded regression suites.

runtimeRole.qualification: Company tables retain normal DML grants; immutable history, legal pointers and eligible purge disposal are additionally guarded by enabled triggers and service authorization. Append-only audit-store grant ceilings are assessed by the canonical full grant audit.
